description: This file contains the implementation of the LuceneQueryService class, which provides search functionality using Lucene.Net, including query creation, search execution, and tokenization.

classes.name: LuceneQueryService
classes.description: Implements ILuceneQueryService to perform search operations using Lucene.Net, including query creation, sorting, and tokenization.

methods.name: SearchAsync
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous search based on the provided query context and JSON query object, returning top documents and hit count.

methods.name: CreateQueryFragment
methods.description: Creates a Lucene query fragment based on the provided JSON object and query providers.

methods.name: Tokenize
methods.description: Tokenizes input text into a list of strings using the specified analyzer.
